paragraphs: The Defender D250 is part of the modern L663 generation, introduced in 2020 as a replacement for the D240. It uses the Ingenium AJ300D — a 3.0-litre inline-six diesel with mild-hybrid technology, producing 247bhp and 420Nm of torque. It sits between the D200 (200bhp) and D300 (296bhp) in the diesel range, offering a blend of power and efficiency. The AJ300D is a six-cylinder engine, distinct from the four-cylinder AJ200D used in earlier L663 diesel models (D200 and D240). The mild-hybrid system adds a 48V electrical architecture, which includes the DC-DC converter that can be a failure point on these engines.
about.boldParagraph: We continue to rebuild and replace AJ300D engines for every Defender D250 on the road.

cards.body: A 3.0-litre inline-six diesel fitted to the Defender D250 from 2020 to present (L663 generation). Known for timing chain wear (shared with other Ingenium diesel engines), DC-DC converter failure on MHEV variants, and early production (2019-2020) electrical injector faults. We replace timing chains, injector seals, bearings, gaskets and the DC-DC converter as standard on every AJ300D rebuild.

compatibility.intro: The D250 is a specific tune of the Ingenium AJ300D diesel engine, fitted exclusively to the L663-generation Defender. It should not be confused with the D200 (4-cylinder AJ200D) or D300 (higher-output version of the same AJ300D engine). Before we quote or supply anything, we confirm:

points.text: Your exact engine code (AJ300D) via registration or VIN
Whether your build falls in the early production period (2019-2020) for injector fault coverage

compatibility.footer: This is why we always start with your registration rather than a generic Defender quote — it protects you from paying for parts that don't fit your actual car.
